title: prefill-decode-chunked-speculative-stage-overlap-kernel-scheduler-kv-cache-optimizations
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: Prefill and decode stages in the inference pipeline have historically serialized work in ways that hurt tail latency and throughput for mixed short/long sequence workloads. This PR implements an end-to-end set of optimizations focused on chunked prefill, speculative prefill for early KV-cache warmup, and tighter cooperation between the kernel scheduler and KV cache prefetching to enable stage overlap without violating correctness. Summary of changes: Introduced chunked prefill that splits long input prefill into small micro-batches to reduce single-request blocking and enable interleaving with decode tokens. Added speculative prefill path: when a decode is expected to request next-token logits, start background prefill of likely next-key blocks (heuristic-driven) to reduce stall when decode switches to using those keys. Kernel scheduler changes: new per-worker priority queues and lightweight preemption points so prefill micro-batches can yield to latency-critical decode iterations, and decode iterations can be prioritized when their KV dependencies are warmed. KV-cache prefetch and eviction improvements: prefetching now supports speculative keys from the prefill heuristics and records prefetch hit/miss metrics for tuning; eviction policy adjusted to prefer keeping active decode keys. Continuous batching tweaks: improved delay/size heuristics that consider stage overlap so batches don't artificially delay decode progress. Added unit and integration tests for chunked prefill and speculative flows, and new microbench harness scenarios (mixed short/long sequences, streaming decode) for performance regression checks. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1985) [x] Unit tests [x] Integration perf harness [x] Metrics and dashboards updated [x] Release notes entry prepared. Performance summary (microbench, internal lab): Mixed workload (50% short=32 tokens, 50% long=1024 tokens) on p4d: overall throughput +18% tokens/sec. Tail latency (p99) for short requests when system is under mixed load: -22% p99. Prefill stall reduction: median stall time from 12.4ms -> 3.1ms for speculative-warmed paths. CPU/GPU utilization improved by enabling tighter overlap, measured as 9-12% GPU occupancy increase for the tested workload.

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Can you add an integration test that simulates a decode that switches to a previously unseen key mid-sequence? Need to ensure no correctness regressions under preemption.

Priya Natarajan (author): Added serve/tests/integration/prefill_speculative_test.py that covers the switch case and validates logits match non-speculative baseline. Also added an assert in the prefetch path to avoid race where prefetch tries to evict active decode keys.

Laura Chen: The new kernel_scheduler hooks look good, but we observed occasional spikes in scheduler latency in the CI perf runs. Can we add a microbenchmark and a safety limit to fall back to the old scheduler if preemption overhead exceeds threshold?

Priya Natarajan (author): Added a microbenchmark harness and a runtime flag (scheduler.preemption_enabled) with a conservative default. Tests in CI show preemption overhead <1.2ms for our common cases; added guard to disable when >5ms.
Mateo Ruiz: Please add observability for speculative prefetch efficacy (hit/miss ratio) and a dashboard so SREs can tune heuristics.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added metrics and updated console dashboard (console/dashboards/prefill_dashboard.json).
ci_checks: integration-perf: mixed-workload-harness - flaky on first run (investigating), rerun passed
release_notes: Runtime: improve prefill-decode overlap and reduce tail latency via chunked prefill, speculative KV prefetching, and kernel scheduler preemption. Expected throughput and p99 improvements for mixed short/long workloads. Ops: new metrics (prefill.prefetch_hits, prefill.prefetch_misses, prefill.stall_ms) and dashboard panels added.
post_merge_actions: Rollout: feature gate enabled behind runtime flag 'prefill.stage_overlap_enabled' - gradual rollout plan in ENG-2041
Monitoring: watch prefill.prefetch_miss_ratio and scheduler.preemption_latency for first 72h
Rollback: disable 'prefill.stage_overlap_enabled' if p99 regressions observed
